seo.seo_title: OpenAI-compatible API: change the base address
seo.seo_description: Change the base address and key of your OpenAI client to call Nexora AI API. cURL, Python and JavaScript examples, plus errors, limits and how billing works.

blocks.role: Promesse du tutoriel : changer l'adresse de base et la clé, le reste du code ne bouge pas.

translation.headline: Change the base address, keep your code.
translation.subheadline: Nexora AI API follows the OpenAI API format. Three lines change in an existing client: the base address, the key and the model identifier. cURL, Python and JavaScript examples.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : les trois éléments à changer et les points d'accès pris en charge.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
To use Nexora AI API, change the base address and the key of your OpenAI client; the rest of your code stays the same. The base address is the site's address followed by /v1, the key starts with nxk_, and the model is given by its public identifier. Chat, embeddings and the model list are supported.

A base address is the common beginning of all the API's addresses. An embedding is a text turned into a series of numbers that can be compared.

blocks.role: Les trois lignes à changer, avec trois exemples exacts (cURL, Python, JavaScript) tirés de la documentation de l'API.

translation.title: The three lines to change.
translation.body:
Replace https://www.example.com/v1 with the base address shown in the API documentation, nxk_your_api_key with your key and nexora/model-name with the identifier of a catalogue model. These examples are the ones in the documentation; they show no output because the gateway is not open for sale.

cURL

curl https://www.example.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nxk_your_api_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nexora/model-name",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Hello!" }],
    "max_tokens": 200
  }'

Python

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://www.example.com/v1", api_key="nxk_your_api_key")

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="nexora/model-name",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
    max_tokens=200,
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

JavaScript

import OpenAI from "openai";

const client = new OpenAI({ baseURL: "https://www.example.com/v1", apiKey: "nxk_your_api_key" });

const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "nexora/model-name",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello!" }],
  max_tokens: 200,
});
console.log(response.choices[0].message.content);

blocks.role: Points d'accès pris en charge, sous forme de tableau.

translation.title: What is supported.
translation.body:
Supported API endpoints
EndpointRoleDetails
POST /v1/chat/completionsChatStreaming, tools and response formats; a key is required.
POST /v1/embeddingsTexts turned into numbersOne text or a list of texts, for embeddings-type models.
GET /v1/modelsList of published modelsPrices, context and hosting location; the public catalogue needs no key.

To receive the response as it is produced, add stream: true. The cost is settled at the end of the stream, from actual usage.

const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "nexora/model-name",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Tell me a short story." }],
  max_tokens: 400,
  stream: true,
});

for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content ?? "");
}

blocks.role: Ce qui n'est pas pris en charge : un seul choix, paramètres propres à un fournisseur ignorés, plafond de max_tokens.

cards.title: One choice per request.
cards.text: The n parameter must be 1; any other value returns the 400 unsupported_parameter error.

cards.title: Provider-specific parameters.
cards.text: Only parameters known to the OpenAI format are forwarded; the others are ignored.

cards.title: A max_tokens that is too large.
cards.text: It cannot exceed the model's cap or the remaining context: the API returns 400 rather than truncating.

cards.title: Another provider's identifiers.
cards.text: The model is given by the public identifier in the Nexora AI catalogue; another service's identifier is not found there.

blocks.role: Erreurs : tableau des statuts, avec un exemple réel de réponse à une clé invalide observé sur la pile de développement.

translation.title: Errors and limits.
translation.body:
Errors follow the OpenAI format: an error object with a message, a type and a code. Messages are written in French; test the code field. Here is the response actually observed on October 29, 2026, on a development server, for an invalid key:

HTTP 401
{"error":{"message":"Clé API invalide ou absente. Utilisez l'en-tête « Authorization: Bearer nxk_… ».","type":"authentication_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_api_key"}}
API errors
StatusCodeMeaning
401invalid_api_key, api_key_revoked, api_key_expiredMissing or unknown key, revoked or expired key.
402insufficient_quota, account_blocked, api_key_spend_cap_reachedInsufficient balance, blocked account or key spending cap reached.
404model_not_foundModel does not exist or is not allowed for this key.
400invalid_json, missing_model, invalid_messages, invalid_max_tokens, context_length_exceeded, unsupported_parameterInvalid request; the param field names the faulty parameter.
429rate_limit_exceededPer-minute request or token limit reached; see the Retry-After header.
502 or 503upstream_error, upstream_unavailable, upstream_overloaded, gateway_unavailableThe model's provider is unavailable or overloaded: try again. Nothing is charged.

blocks.role: Facturation en trois temps : réserver, régler, lire le coût ; état de la vente.

translation.title: Billing in three steps.
translation.intro: Accounts and payments work in test mode only for now: what follows describes how it works, not an offer open for sale.

cards.title: Reserve.
cards.text: Each request first reserves its maximum cost. Without enough balance, the API returns 402 before any call to the model.

cards.title: Settle.
cards.text: The request is settled at the actual cost from input and output tokens; the rest of the reservation is released.

cards.title: Read the cost.
cards.text: Each complete response carries the x-nexora-cost-micro header, in millionths of a Canadian dollar. A key can have a spending cap.

blocks.role: Questions du tutoriel : modifications du code, identifiant de modèle, flux, coût, achat.

items.question: What do I need to change in my code?
items.answer: Three values: the base address (the site's address followed by /v1), the key (it starts with nxk_) and the model identifier. The rest of the call, including the official OpenAI libraries, does not change.

items.question: Where do I find a model's identifier?
items.answer: In the public catalogue or through GET /v1/models, which needs no key. The identifier looks like space/name, for example nexora/model-name.

items.question: Does streaming work?
items.answer: Yes: add stream: true. The cost is settled at the end of the stream; if you close the connection part-way, only tokens already delivered are billed.

items.question: How do I know what a request cost?
items.answer: Each complete response carries the x-nexora-cost-micro header, in millionths of a Canadian dollar. Usage by day and by model also appears in the customer area.

items.question: Can I use the API in production today?
items.answer: Not in self-service: accounts and payments work in test mode only and no real payment is accepted. For a project, write to us.
